findingClass: an ipo_field_plan row retired at the attempts cap (FIELD_PLAN_RECLAIM_MAX_ATTEMPTS) by a CONFIGURATION cause — a manifest rank naming a source with no field mapping, a DOC rank with no documentType, or a source with no registered fetcher — rather than by a real failure (#884: 6,220 staging rows across 72 IPOs on 2026-09-23)
whatItAsks: no CHECK_FAILED plan row at attempts >= the cap has a recorded cause that is a configuration gap (isConfigGapAtCapRow, the pinned mirror of the repository's FIELD_PLAN_CONFIG_GAP_CAUSE_MARKERS)
alarmsWhen: any non-zero, named by IPO slug and table.field
scope: every IPO, every status and segment, prod + staging slots; state = CHECK_FAILED, attempts >= cap
consumerReason: a structural fact about the attempts accounting, read by row identity each run — sibling of pull_plan_stuck_reclaim
note: Companion CI half: scraper/tests/unit/config/manifest-rank-coverage-gaps.test.ts lists every manifest rank the walk cannot ask (215 on 2026-09-23: 100 CHITTORGARH, 52 BSE and 49 NSE no-mapping, 7 DOC no-documentType, 6 REG and 1 INVESTORGAIN_GMP no-fetcher) against a shrink-only baseline, so a NEW gap fails CI. Expected first-run value on staging before the repair is applied: 4,811 rows (repair dry run 2026-09-23).
